expressions.name: time_derivative_objective
expressions.formula: \partial_t J(\mathbf V,\mathbf u) = \int_D \ell \chi \operatorname{div}\mathbf V \,dx + \int_D \chi \left(\operatorname{div}\mathbf V \left(\lambda \operatorname{div}(\mathbf u)^2 + 2\mu(\pmb\varepsilon(\mathbf u):\pmb\varepsilon(\mathbf u)^\top)\right) + 2\left(\lambda \operatorname{div}(\mathbf u)^2 \operatorname{tr}(-(\nabla \mathbf u \cdot \nabla \mathbf V))\operatorname{div}(\mathbf u)^{-1} + \mu\left((\partial_t \pmb\varepsilon(\mathbf V,\mathbf u):\pmb\varepsilon(\mathbf u)^\top) + (\pmb\varepsilon(\mathbf u):\partial_t \pmb\varepsilon(\mathbf V,\mathbf u)^\top)\right)\right)\right)\,dx

expressions.name: adjoint_objective_derivative
expressions.formula: \partial_{(\mathbf u,\mathbf v)}J(\mathbf u,\mathbf v) = \int_D 2\chi \left(\lambda \operatorname{div}(\mathbf u)^2 \operatorname{div}\mathbf v \operatorname{div}(\mathbf u)^{-1} + \mu\left((\pmb\varepsilon(\mathbf u):\pmb\varepsilon(\mathbf v)^\top) + (\pmb\varepsilon(\mathbf v):\pmb\varepsilon(\mathbf u)^\top)\right)\right)\,dx

expressions.name: lagrangian
expressions.formula: \mathcal L([\mathbf u],[\mathbf v]) = J(\mathbf u) - \int_{\partial D} f(\mathbf e_y\cdot\mathbf v) \,ds_x + \int_D \chi \left(\lambda \operatorname{div}\mathbf v \operatorname{tr}(\pmb\varepsilon(\mathbf u)) + 2\mu(\pmb\varepsilon(\mathbf u):\nabla\mathbf v)\right)\,dx

boundaries.name: \Gamma_2
boundaries.rationale: Gamma_2 mapped to FreeFEM rectangle label 2 (right edge).

boundaries.name: \Gamma_4
boundaries.rationale: Gamma_4 mapped to FreeFEM rectangle label 4 (left edge).

boundaries.name: \partial D
boundaries.description: Loaded boundary: vertical traction f e_y applied on the top edge
boundaries.rationale: The loaded boundary is assigned to top edge label 3; f = -5 gives a downward bridge-deck load.

boundaries.name: \Gamma_1
boundaries.description: Free boundary (bottom edge), homogeneous natural condition
boundaries.rationale: Completes the rectangular design domain with a zero-traction boundary.

fields.name: u
fields.rationale: Displacement field; Dirichlet labels are the designed mesh labels for Gamma_2 and Gamma_4.

fields.name: u_tilde
fields.rationale: Adjoint displacement; homogeneous Dirichlet condition on the same supports.

constants.name: ell
constants.description: Lagrange multiplier for volume penalisation in the objective
constants.rationale: Extracted value retained; description clarified as volume penalty weight.

constants.name: mu
constants.rationale: Extracted value retained; the original label 'Poisson's ratio' was corrected.

constants.name: lambda
constants.rationale: Extracted value retained; the original label 'Young's modulus' was corrected.

constants.name: f
constants.description: Applied vertical surface traction on the loaded boundary (negative = downward)
constants.rationale: Sign gives a downward bridge-deck load with e_y pointing upward.

constants.name: youngs_modulus
constants.description: Young's modulus derived from Lamé parameters
constants.rationale: Derived from E = mu(3 lambda + 2 mu)/(lambda + mu) with lambda = 1 and mu = 8.

constants.name: nu
constants.description: Poisson's ratio derived from Lamé parameters
constants.rationale: Derived from nu = lambda/(2(lambda + mu)) with lambda = 1 and mu = 8.

characteristic_function.rationale: Weak material value 1/1000 prevents singular stiffness in void regions.
